tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gser 'od dam pa'i mdo'i le'u las bshags pa'i smon lam mdor bsdus bris pa bzhugs so//

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dren mchog thub pa'i spyan sngar ni// byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog /mnal ba'i rmi lam 'di lta bu// gser 'od 'bar ba'i snang ba yis// phyogs bcu khyab dbus rin po che'i// shing drung bai ḍūrya yi khrir// sangs rgyas dpag yas bzhugs pa'i sar// bram ze'i gzugs kyis rnga bo che// brdungs pa'i sgra las tshig 'di byung*// gser 'od dam pa'i rnga sgra yis// stong gsum 'jig rten ngan song dang*// gshin rje dbul dang phongs la sogs// zhi nas thub dbang 'jigs med ltar// 'jigs bral mchog ni thob par shog /thub pa'i yon tan ci lta bar// skye bos de dag kun thob shog /'gro kun tshangs dbyangs ldan pa dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub la reg shog /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// bskal pa bsam mi khyab bzhugs shing*// 'gro phan chos rnams ston pa dang*// nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel bar shog /dug gsum nyon mongs zhi gyur cig /ngan song gnas pa rus pa'i lus| |me 'bar rnams ni rnga chen sgra// rgyal la phyag 'tshal thob par shog /'gro kun skye mang dran pa dang*// thub pa rtag tu dran gyur cig /de yi gsung nyid thos pa dang*// de dag rnams la rtag 'grogs shing*// sdig spong dge ba spyod gyur cig /'gro kun smon lam kun 'grub cing*// dmyal gnas me dang grang ba dang*// yi dwags sdug bsngal drag po'i tshogs// de dag thams cad zhi bar shog /rten dang dpung gnyen skyabs med pa// de kun skyabs su bdag gyur cig /rgyal ba thams cad bdag la dgongs| |bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// sngon chad mi bzad sdig pa'i las// gang bgyis rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ni// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// pha ma sangs rgyas dge ba las// der mi 'dzin dang 'byor ldan rigs// longs spyod gzhon pa sogs dregs pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*| |nyan nyes smra nyes nyes par bgyis// nyes pa dmigs su ma bltas pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// mi shes blo dang mun pa'i sems// sdig grogs dbang gyur 'khrug rtsod dga'// mya ngan dbang gis gang nongs pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// nad dbang nor dang chog sems bral// 'phags min skye 'dres phrag dog dang*// ser sna g.yo sgyu'i nyes pa kun// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// phongs dus 'dod 'jigs rgyu dag dang*// phyug min gyur dang g.yo 'dod dang*// khro dang bkres skom gyis nyes pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bza' btung bud med rgyu sogs phyir// nyon mongs ngan song lus ngag yid// nyes spyad sdig par gang gyur pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// sangs rgyas chos tshogs rang sangs rgyas// byang sems chos smra chos tshogs la// gus par ma bgyis chos spangs pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// pha mar ma gus sun 'byin pa// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal dregs pas gang bsgribs pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bdag gis rgyal rnams mchod pa dang*// 'gro kun 'khor ba las sgrol zhing*// sa bcu bgrod la sangs rgyas shog

/ji srid sdug bsngal srid mtsho las// de kun thar bgyid nus srid du// sems can re re'i phyir yang ni// bskal ba bye ba spyad par bgyi// mdo 'dis las rnams byang bgyid pa// ston 'di 'gro kun bstan pa bgyi// bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig /lan gcig bshags pas kun 'byang 'gyur// las kyi sgrib kun zad 'gyur ba// gser 'od dam pa 'dis bshags nas// sa bcu la ni gnas par bgyid// srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol cing*// thams cad mkhyen du rdzogs pa dang*// stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar bgyid// rgyal ba 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs// bdag gi nongs pa gzung du gsol// bdag gis sngon chad sdig bgyis par// mya ngan 'jigs gzir bdag nongs so// yid dman gang du sdig bgyis pa// bdag gi 'gal ba ma mchis so// 'gro kun mi shes sdig spyad pas// nongs par bzung la dag par gsol// bdag gi sdig pa'i dri ma rnams// snying rje'i chu yis bkru bar gsol// sngon dang da ltar bsags pa'i sdig /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bdag nongs pa yi sdig pa'i las/ phyin chad mi bgyi bsdam par bgyi// bdag nongs sdig pa mi 'chab bo// lus kyis bgyis pa rnam gsum dang*// ngag gis smras pa bzhi dag dang*// yid kyis bsams pa rnam gsum ste/ mi dge bcu sogs bdag 'chags so// de spangs dge bcu bsgrub par bgyi// sa dang stobs bcu bdag gyur cig /sdig pa mi 'dod 'bras thob pa// rgyal rnams spyan sngar bdag 'chags so// gling 'di dang ni gling gzhan du// gang gis bgyis pa'i dge ba la// rtag tu bdag ni yi rang ngo*// bdag gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// de dges byang chub mchog reg shog /srid 'gro'i nyam nga byis blo yis// sdig pa gang bgyis deng 'chags so// skye dang srid pa 'jig rten dang*// g.yo dang nyon mongs sdig grogs 'phrad// srid dang 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*// gti mug ngal dang dus dang ni// bsod nams grub pa nyam nga'i rigs// sdig pa de kun so sor 'chags| |sangs rgyas gser mdog yon tan ldan// de la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// mi shes sel ba'i nyi ma dang*// nyon mongs gdung sel chu shel dbang*// nad 'joms sman rgyal mtshan dpe ldan// mdzes pa khyod la bdag dga'o// khyod kyi yon tan phung po ni// sus kyang gzhal bar nus min gyi// de lta'i ngo mtshar can khyod ni// bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyur cig

/bdag gi dge ba'i las kyi mthus// 'jig rten 'di ni rgyal 'byung zhing*// 'gro phan chos rnams rab ston cing*// sems can sdug bsngal las sgrol shog /stobs chen bdud las rgyal ba dang*// chos 'khor rab dge bskor bar bgyi// bskal pa bsam mi khyab gnas shing*// bdud rtsis sems can tshim par bgyi// ji ltar rgyal ba phar phyin drug /rdzogs pa de ltar bdag bgyi'o// nyon mongs sdug bsngal sel ba dang*// dug gsum zhi zhing sngon dang phyis// skye ba dpag yas dran par bgyi// thub mchog rtag tu dran pa dang*/ */ des gsung rtag tu thos par bgyi// dge 'dis rtag tu sangs rgyas dang*// 'grogs shing mos pa rnyed par shog /sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa dang*// zhing rnams kun gyi srog chags rnams| |'jig rten sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing*// dbang po ma tshang nad can dang*// nyam chung skyabs med gyur pa dag /dbang po tshang zhing nad las thar// stobs rgyas skyabs dang 'phrad par shog /rgyal po chom rkun 'jigs pa sogs// de dag rab dge zhi gyur cig /rdeg dang 'ching dang gzir ba dang*// phongs dang gsod pa la sogs pa// gang dag sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams// de dang de las thar bar shog /bsad pa srog dang ldan pa dang*// bkres skom dbul por gyur rnams kyang*// de dag zas skom rnyed gyur cig /longs dang 'on dang gcer bu dang*// sems can dbul por gyur rnams kyang*// gzugs mthong sgra thos gos rnyed cing*// gter dang rin chen gos rnyed shog /'gro kun bde dang ldan pa dang*| |sdug bsngal tshogs rnams rab zhi zhing*// kun kyang lta na sdug pa dang*// gzugs bzang mdzes shing tshul shes dang*// rtag tu bag dang ldan gyur cig /'gro ba kun gyis nyer spyod pa// mkho dgu yid la bsam ma thag /de dag skad cig rnyed gyur cig /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan kun tu// sdug bsngal sgra tsam mi grag shog

/'gro kun mi 'phrod mthong ma gyur| |de dag kha dog rgya chen dang*// phan tshun 'od 'byed 'gyur bar shog /mi yi 'jig rten phun tshogs kun// de dag bsams par de skye zhing*// bsam pa thams cad bsams ma thag |bsod nams thams cad yongs rdzogs shog /spos sogs nyer spyod dngos po kun// 'bad med dus gsum ljon shing las// 'bab cing 'gro bas longs spyod shog /rgyal dang byang chub nyan rang gi// rdul bral dri med chos rnams la// phyogs bcu kun tu mchod par shog /'gro dman mi khom brgyad thar zhing*// dal ba dam pa thob pa dang*// rtag tu rgyal dang 'grogs thob shog /dus kun mthon po'i rigs thob cing*// 'bru nor mdzod rnams 'byor ba dang*// snyan grags gzugs dang kha dog dbyibs// bskal pa du mar legs brgyan shog /bud med thams cad phor 'gyur zhing*// dpa' brtul mkhas shing gsal bar shog /de kun byang chub phyir spyod cing*// pha rol phyin drug spyod pa dang*// byang chub shing drung bai ḍūr khrir// sangs rgyas bder bzhugs mthong ba dang*// des bstan chos rnams thob par shog /bdag gis sdig pa'i las bsgrubs pas// de 'bras mi 'dod 'bras thob bcas// da lta nyid du zad gyur cig /'gro gang srid par rab bcings pa// shes rab lag pas 'grol bar shog /sdug bsngal kun las thar gyur cig /'dzam gling 'di yi 'gro rnams dang*// 'jig rten gzhan gyi 'gro rnams kyi// bsod nams kun la bdag yi rang*// lus ngag yid kyis bsgrubs pa yi// yi rang bsod nams stobs kyi mthus// bdag gi smon lam myur 'grub shog /byang chub rdul bral thob gyur cig /rtag tu dri bral mos pa'i blos// phyag 'tshal bsngo ba brjod pa yis// bskal pa drug cu ngan song las// thar zhing tshigs bcad 'di brjod pas// kun gyis bstod cing bsngags pa dang*// kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur// yan lag dbang po kun tshang zhing*// bsod nams yon tan tshogs dang ldan// mi dbang rgyal po rtag mchod cing*// de dang de dag 'dra bar 'gyur// gang gis bshags pa 'di thos pa// de dag sangs rgyas gcig gam gnyis// gsum la sogs pa ma yin par// stong phrag rgyal ba'i mdun dag tu// rnam dkar bsod nams byas pa yin/

zhes pa ni gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las bshags pa'i le'u ste/ le'u bzhi pa byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gi rmi lam du rnga bo'i sgra las byung ba'i bshags pa dang*/ smon lam rnams kyi don ma tshang ba med cing 'gal 'khrul gyi dri ma spangs nas tshig sna cung zad bstungs te/ rang gis kha 'don bya ba'i slad dang sems cad gzhan dag la'ang phan pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag cing*/ 'jang grwa gsol dpon bsod nams kyis kyang bskul bar brten/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas/ sa stag rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar po'i stong pa gnyis pa'i dus dge bar/ bye ri stag rnam par rtse ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i re'u mig kun gsal gsang sngags kyi pho brang du/ mgyogs par bris pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bdag gis khur du len cing*/ bdag gi bde ba'i rgyu 'bras bu dang bcas pa sems can thams cad phyogs dang ris su ma chad par skal mnyam chen po 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ stu sarba dza ga taṃ//
